items.statement: Management expects sustainable good earnings for next 6 to 8 quarters on favorable BOPET supply-demand.
items.quote: So , all this give us confidence that we should have sustainable good earnings going forward, not only for the next 3 quarters, but I would go on to say, for next 6 to 8 quarters.

items.statement: Company expects to reach INR2,000-2,200 crore revenue in next 2-3 years.
items.quote: Yes. I think we are steadily marching towards that, and we should definitely be hitting there in next 2 years to 3 years.

items.statement: Targeting VAS products at 50-60% of film volumes over next 2-3 years.
items.quote: Encouraged by the recent performance and positive outcomes of our strategic focus, we are targeting proportion of VAS products at about 50% to 60% over the next 2 to 3 years.

items.statement: VAS contribution expected up to 35% of portfolio by exit quarter this fiscal.
items.quote: See, we are seeing up to 35% contribution of VAS product out of our own -- up to the overall portfolio by the quarter end, I mean, in the exit quarter.

items.statement: Specialty Polymers targeting 20% CAGR over next 3-5 years; FY27 flat to single-digit growth.
items.quote: We are targeting growth at a CAGR of 20% over the next 3 to 5 years in the Specialty Polymer segment.

items.statement: Specialty Polymers revenue growth expected to recover by end of this financial year.
items.quote: However, given the strength of our business development pipeline, we expect to recover the revenue growth in this business by the end of this financial year.

items.statement: Specialty Polymers EBIT margin may moderate in percentage terms but absolute EBITDA/EBIT to grow.
items.quote: But you are right. As we go forward, we are g oing to see some moderation of the percentage margins, right? Because the mid-margin is going to pull down the high specialty margins a little bit in percentage terms.

items.statement: 12-micron commodity film spreads were INR28-30 last quarter and are holding resilient.
items.quote: So, spreads last quarter were in the range of INR28 to INR30. When I say spread, I mean VA, value-add over raw material for 12-micron film.

items.statement: BOPET supply-demand balance expected to hold for next 6-8 quarters, keeping margins steady.
items.quote: See, like I told you that we are very positive that for next 6 quarters to 8 quarters, the global and domestic supply-demand balance is going to hold. And I think that is going to give us some respite and is going to keep the margin steady.

items.statement: Only 2-3 new BOPET lines expected in next 1.5-2 years; demand growth outpacing capacity.
items.quote: We are expecting another 2 to 3 lines coming up in the next 1.5 to 2 years.

items.statement: No major capex planned apart from sustenance and maintenance capex.
items.quote: No. So, apart from our sustenance and maintenance capex, we are not planning any major capex.

items.statement: Debt repayment target of INR100 crores this year; gross debt to fall to INR620 crores.
items.quote: So, this year, the debt repayment target is around INR100 crores.

items.statement: ELITe JV to raise additional debt in JV company, not on Ester balance sheet; not consolidated.
items.quote: So, there is going to be additional debt, which will be raised in the JV company, not in Ester balance sheet.

items.statement: ELITe facility targeted operational in CY2028; land acquisition to conclude in 2 months.
items.quote: The facility is targeted to become operational in CY 2028 and will use Loop's proprietary depolymerization technology to convert 100% textile waste streams into virgin -quality monomers, which will then be polymerized into virgin-quality polyester resin.

items.statement: Expects FMCG revenue to cross INR12,500 crores in FY27, up from INR11,000+ crores in FY26
items.quote: Last year our total sales from overall FMCG including the HPC was INR11,000 crores plus, and this year my estimation is that we should certainly cross increase it by 10% plus and we should be somewhere closer to INR12,500 crores in our revenues.

items.statement: TSP EBITDA margin guidance maintained at 16-18% for the year
items.quote: We are quite confident that we will continue the guidance that we have always given that our margins will be 16% to 18% on the TSP. I think we will be able to maintain that.

items.statement: Edible oil EBITDA margin construct guided between 3-5% volume growth, aiming for consistent 5%+ margins
items.quote: How do we increase our margin construct typically what we say between 2% and 4% towards consistently 5-plus percent will be a big driver of growth.

items.statement: Staples volume grew 5% with 12% pricing inflation in Q1 FY27; rural demand caution flagged for current quarter
items.quote: The volumes have grown by 5% and the pricing inflation that came in was almost about 12%.

items.statement: E-commerce and quick commerce revenue contribution at 15% currently, targeting 20% within 18 months
items.quote: Currently, if I were to put those numbers together, we right now do close to about 15% between modern trade and e-commerce, quick commerce. We want to take that number up to 20%.

items.statement: Oil palm cultivated area 1,15,861 hectares as of June 2026, 37% in prime yielding phase (7-25 years)
items.quote: As of 30th June '26, the cultivated area stood at 1,15,861 hectares with nearly 37% of the area in the prime yielding phase of 7 to 25 years, against total allocated area of 6.63 lakh hectares.

items.statement: Calibrated price increases in edible oils; targeted discounts and smaller pack sizes in FMCG to remain competitive
items.quote: We took calibrated price increases in the edible oil segment while using targeted discounts in our FMCG portfolio to remain competitive. We also introduced smaller pack sizes to address changing consumer needs and market requirements.

items.statement: HPC acquisition (INR1,100 crores slump sale) generated INR600 crores EBITDA last year; already repaid acquisition cost
items.quote: It was generating a margin of INR600 crores, and we have paid INR1,100 crores which is less than 18, 19 months of profitability and which has already in last 18 months it has already repaid that much and built up assets substantially.

items.statement: Revenue guidance of Rs 300 crore for FY27 reaffirmed; Q1 FY27 revenue at Rs 60.95 crore, balance order book of Rs 150 crore to be executed this year plus pipeline orders by March
items.quote: Sir we have done already 60 in Q1. And the balance about 150 crores, the order book that also needs to be finished in this financial year. And definitely there are some orders in pipeline which also we would need to do it by March. So 300 we are in line Sir.

items.statement: Fabrication capacity being expanded from ~6,000 tons to 18,000 tons/year (1,500 tons/month) at Tedesra Unit for power sector and fabricated bogies
items.quote: Sir, we would be in a position to do about 1500 tons a month about what the plan is that capacity is 1500 tons a month that is about 18,000 tons. So that is but at the moment what we are doing is about without this capacity expansion we are doing about 6000, from 6000 we want to grade it at least 6000 or 7000, 8000 ton

items.statement: PAT margin target maintained at 15-20% for EPC projects; overall PAT margins expected to improve via niche complex products despite railway/power fabrication at similar margins
items.quote: Anything because of its because of the kind of things that are associated with the EPC project. That is again that I am making the box smaller. If anything less than 15 to 20%, we are not interested. So that is why my box is very small.

items.statement: Strong demand across steel, power, railways, defence, oil & gas, shipbuilding; multiple sectors opening simultaneously with broader opportunity landscape than ever before
items.quote: Across thermal and power, railways, defence, oil and gas, shipbuilding, multiple opportunities have opened for the company at the same time. These opportunities are clearly visible to us.

items.statement: Strategic shift to faster-moving products (railway bogies 30-45 day cycle, power fabrication via RXIL/Invoice Mart at 30-35 days) to reduce operating cycle from ~120 days to 60-70 days by FY28
items.quote: By FY28, we expect an operating cycle with the much more controlled and disciplined working capital structure, with a targeting days of 60 to 70 days.

items.statement: Defence revenue share targeted at 5-10% in FY27 and 10-15% in FY28 (including shipbuilding); collaborating with ordnance factories (e.g., Gun Carriage Factory Jabalpur) for hardware/components using flexible machining
items.quote: It will be 5 to 10% because I would add the shipbuilding to the same. So it will be 10 to 15% and it will continue to be 10 to 15% in the next financial year also.

items.statement: Management declined to provide FY27 revenue growth guidance, stating it would not be prudent to give a number at this time.
items.quote: I don't think it will be prudent to give you any number at this time.

items.statement: Russia licensing arrangement for Exblifep has estimated 10-year value of approximately USD178 million.
items.quote: In Russia, the estimated 10-year value of our licensing arrangement is approximately USD178 million.

items.statement: 7-ACA pricing stable at weighted average ~USD60 for last 10-12 years; limited room for drastic price reduction by Chinese suppliers.
items.quote: The pricing in 7-ACA has been stable over the last 10 to 12 years. The weighted average is about USD60. So, we believe that there is not much room to reduce prices drastically.

items.statement: Regulated market demand typically stronger in H2 (winter season); Q1 FY27 described as mediocre for regulated products.
items.quote: last year trend, we have seen that the second half is generally having more demand from the regulated. It's probably the winter season there.

items.statement: 7-ACA project ramp-up uncertain; guided 12 months to full utilization but may take longer per Aurobindo experience.
items.quote: We've guiding 12 months, but you know -- and I have said that again earlier that Aurobindo looking at other experience, it might be longer.

items.statement: Cefixime margins under maximum stress in rest-of-world markets due to pricing pressure.
items.quote: Cefixime as a product is under maximum stress with respect to margins.

items.statement: 7-ACA commercial batch target March 2027; ramp-up to 80-100% utilization by end of first year; long-term split 80% captive, 20% third-party sales.
items.quote: Our ramp-up plan is to go to about 80% to 100% by the end of the first year. Initially, it would be slow and then increasing progressively. With respect to utilization, our long-term guidance on this is 80% in-house use and 20% selling to third party.

items.statement: Cefiderocol facility commissioning target December 2026; validation and initial batches Jan-Mar 2027; commercial launch subject to DCGI approval.
items.quote: We target commissioning by December of '26, followed by validation and initial batches during January to March '27 period. Commercial launch will be subject to the approval process from DCGI.

items.statement: Exblifep Europe volumes grew 300% in Q3 FY26, 170% in Q4 FY26, and 50% in Q1 FY27 quarter-over-quarter.
items.quote: In Europe, the business is growing at a steady manner whilst volumes grew by approximately 300% in Q3 of '26, 170% in Q4 of '26, and about 50% in Q1 of '27.

items.statement: NP-NC segment revenue ~INR21 crores in Q1 FY27; working on new molecules and backward integration.
items.quote: So, this quarter sales was INR21 crores, and we are working on a couple of molecules. We are also planning to scale up and backward integrate in these molecules also.

items.statement: Full-year volume target of 10-12 million tons may see 10% variance, implying 9-11 million tons.
items.quote: As mentioned, we have given a target of 10 to 12 and we expect maybe there may be a 10% variance into this target. So we can consider like a 9 to 11 kind of a range.

items.statement: Confident of achieving or exceeding 15 million tons bauxite volume guidance by FY28.
items.quote: We remain confident in our ability to achieve or even cross our guidance of 15 million tons by financial year ’28.

items.statement: Expects around USD1 billion (~INR10,000 crores) bauxite sales at 15 million tons baseline.
items.quote: So even picking that as a baseline kind of number for the next financial year, we can think that around you know, almost about billion dollars of sales we are expecting from bauxite as per the company's plan.

items.statement: EBITDA per ton expected to stay around USD5.5-6 in next one to two quarters.
items.quote: So around USD6 or USD5.5 to USD6 would be a reasonable, expectation.

items.statement: Medium-to-long term EBITDA per ton expected to return closer to earlier ~USD10 levels.
items.quote: So at least we should able to achieve over a medium to longer term closer to the EBITDAs we were achieving earlier which was near USD10.

items.statement: EBITDA to improve significantly possibly in next calendar year as freight normalizes and quota system kicks in.
items.quote: So, we expect EBITDA to improve significantly from now, maybe in the sort of next calendar year, at least this is our expectation.

items.statement: Planning capex of close to INR200 crores across India business verticals.
items.quote: As stated previously, we are also planning a capex close to INR200 crores across various projects and business verticals.

items.statement: Boffa port capacity enhanced to 8 million tons; GSM new jetty to be operational by Q4 FY27 raising capacity to 10 MT.
items.quote: At GSM, the second port, the new jetty is currently under construction and expected to be operational by Q4 of this financial year, increasing capacity from 6 million tons to 10 million tons per annum.

items.statement: Combined port capacity to reach approximately 23 million tons supporting medium-term volume growth.
items.quote: With these developments, our combined port capacity will reach to approximately 23 million tons, providing us with the infrastructure to support the maximized volume growth and sales over the medium terms.

items.statement: Bauxite washing plant of 20,000 tons per day set up; expansion would take about one year if decided.
items.quote: I think the fundamental purpose of bauxite washing plant might be EBITDA neutral but it definitely helps us to increase our total volume and throughput which we can do from a particular location because it makes the more low grade resources into high grade and exportable resources.

items.statement: Guinea bauxite export quota system expected before end of this year, seen as positive for prices.
items.quote: We believe this could be introduced in the near terms and certainly before end of this year.

items.statement: Realizations to remain close to similar levels until quota system provides directional tailwind.
items.quote: I think that the realizations may remain close to similar levels for time being until we have -- I think any kind of directional tailwind would probably come in from the quota system.

items.statement: Four new Chinese refineries expected to add 20-30 million tons bauxite demand over current volumes.
items.quote: Several new refineries are coming on stream, including the four new refineries in China which are expected to create additional bauxite demand of around 20 million tons to 30 million tons over the above current volumes.

items.statement: Freight rates highly volatile; expects volatility to continue across 2027, pressuring margins.
items.quote: The freight rates remains highly volatile. Given the current geopolitical environments, we expect this volatility to continue across 2027.

items.statement: Q2 FY27 expected to produce around 500 wagons versus 300-odd wagons in Q1.
items.quote: We hope to do around 500 wagons in the quarter as compared to 300 and odd wagons in the first quarter.

items.statement: Wagon manufacturing to grow about 45-50%, other businesses 8-10%.
items.quote: whereas the wagon manufacturing would show a growth of approximately more than 45% to 50%.

items.statement: Targets 15-17% EBITDA margin for freight wagon business over medium term.
items.quote: We are targeting an EBITDA margin of 15% to 17% for the freight wagon business over the medium term, with increasing utilization of the existing platform being an important driver towards achieving this objective.

items.statement: Targets 13-15% EBITDA margin for rolling stock interior and allied business segment.
items.quote: We are targeting an EBITDA margin of 13% to 15% for the rolling stock interior and allied business segment supported by passenger coach modernization, new train additions, and expansion to ORVIN, which is the artificial leather business brand, applications and further backward integrations to improve our profitability.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin expected at 15% to 17%.
items.quote: The EBITDA margin has already been also indicated and mentioned. We expect about 15% to 17%.

items.statement: Consolidated order book as of August 11, 2026: INR1,692 crores, with wagons INR1,526 crores.
items.quote: As of August 11, 2026, our consolidated order book stood at approximately INR 1,692 crores, comprising INR1,526 crores of wagon at OFPL and INR 166 crores in the coach interior at Oriental Rail Infrastructure.

items.statement: OFPL order book of INR1,526 crores equals approximately 3,800 wagons.
items.quote: The number of wagons is approximately 3800 wagons.

items.statement: Plans to execute OFPL orders at 200 wagons per month from Q3 FY27.
items.quote: We project to execute at the rate of 200 wagons per month from quarter three of the present financial year.

items.statement: Capacity expansion from 2,400 to 3,600 wagons to cost roughly INR60-70 crores.
items.quote: The capex requirement for wagon expansion from 2,400 wagons to 3,600 wagons would be roughly about INR60 crores to INR70 crores.

items.statement: Plans to expand wagon capacity to 4,800 wagons over 12-18 months from FY28, phased via 3,600.
items.quote: In the long run, over a period of say 12 months to 18 months to 4,800 wagons.

items.statement: Revenue mix: wagons ~75%, seat and berths 16%, rexine upholstery ~5%, other 4%.
items.quote: Looking at the consolidated revenue mix, wagons accounted for approximately 75% of revenue, followed by seat and berths at 16%, rexine upholstery at approximately 5% and other products at 4%.

items.statement: Smart wagon JV with HUM targets INR750 crores annual revenue from 30,000 units at INR2.5-3 lakh each.
items.quote: So we are targeting a revenue of about INR750 crores from this business segment per year.

items.statement: AAR certification being pursued to align with global rail quality standards and support international expansion.
items.quote: We are also applying for AAR certification which is intent to align our manufacturing capacity with global rail quality standards and support our expansion into international markets, which will be a big revenue booster.

items.statement: Expects standalone full-year EBITDA margin of 17%-18% after factoring in price increases.
items.quote: So, with the factoring in, price increases coming in, we are expecting the full year to end at 17%-18% EBITDA margin for the standalone business.

items.statement: Expects FY28 top-line growth in mid-teens and consolidated EBITDA margins of 19%-20%.
items.quote: So, the top-line growth should be in mid -teens, 12%-13% growth, and we are hoping to reach at a consolidated level EBITDA margins of about 19%-20%.

items.statement: Expects current year revenue growth to cross double digits, including the IDBI Bank mandate.
items.quote: No. Including this IDBI Bank, we will have double -digit growth is what our expectation is for the current year.

items.statement: Sought significant price revision from all customers, expecting it to materialize in the current quarter.
items.quote: The company has sought significant price revision with all its customers and expects the same to materialize in the current quarter.

items.statement: Price revision negotiations with banks expected to complete in Q2, effective July or September-October.
items.quote: In Q2, we expect to complete the negotiation.

items.statement: Standalone EBITDA margin fell to 13.5% from 15.9% on higher manpower and gunmen costs.
items.quote: Our standalone EBITDA margins for the quarter Q1 FY27 dropped to 13.5% from 15.9% in the same quarter last year.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin improved marginally to 11.01% from 10.7% on narrowing Acemoney losses.
items.quote: The consolidated EBITDA margin for the quarter improved marginally to 11.01% from 10.7% in the previous quarter due to narrowing down losses in Radiant Acemoney.

items.statement: Direct clients rose to 18.4% of revenues from 14.3% a year earlier; future growth to come from direct clients.
items.quote: Direct clients accounted for 18.4% of our revenues for this quarter, up from 14.3% in the same period last year.

items.statement: Acemoney expects to break even in September and be EBITDA positive for the full quarter in Q3.
items.quote: And we expect it to narrow down further and break-even in the month of September and for the full quarter will be in Q3.

items.statement: Targets deploying over 50,000 Soundboxes in the current financial year, with 60%-70% already in order book.
items.quote: Radiant Acemoney currently provides Soundbox both on outright and rental models and has a target to deploy over 50,000 Soundboxes in the current financial year.

items.statement: Acemoney has over 20,000 BCs, cumulatively deployed over 58,000 Soundboxes, and facilitated Rs. 170 crores transaction volume in Q1.
items.quote: Currently, we have a network of over 20,000 BCs, cumulatively deployed over 58,000 Soundboxes so far, and facilitated a transaction volume of Rs. 170 crores in Q1 FY27.

items.statement: Radiant Valuable Logistics reported Rs. 22.1 million revenue, up 24% sequentially, targeting positive EBITDA this year.
items.quote: Radiant Valuable Logistics reported revenues of Rs. 22.1 million, reporting sequential growth of 24% in Q 1FY27 over Q4FY26, and is well on its way to achieve positive EBITDA in the current financial year.

items.statement: Manpower costs rising 8%-9% annually due to minimum wage hikes and licensed gunmen shortage in southern states.
items.quote: But own employee costs, because of inflationary nature, has increased at about 8 %- 9% every year, whereas our revenue growth has not been.

items.statement: Payment aggregator licence application to be resubmitted by end-August or early September; expects licence by early 2027.
items.quote: We will be resubmitting the application maybe by the end of this month or in the first week of September. Once that is submitted, we expect the application, we expect to get the application in hand by early next year, by January or February 27.

items.statement: FY27 launch pipeline of INR1,600 crores with quarterly phasing: Q2 INR240 crores, Q3 INR800-880 crores, Q4 INR480 crores
items.quote: So, the launch pipeline in total for this financial year is about INR1,600 crores. The launch pipeline, if I give you a synopsis, we are planning to roughly launch about INR240 crores in quarter two, almost about INR800 crores to INR880 crores in quarter three and about INR480 crores in quarter four.

items.statement: FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10-15% YoY
items.quote: So close to 10%- 15% growth we will achieve as compared to the last financial year.

items.statement: EBITDA margin guidance range of 35-37% for next 2 years
items.quote: It will be in the range of 35% to 37%.

items.statement: FY27 presales guidance of INR700 crores for residential plus commercial portfolio
items.quote: Overall, we're going to be targeting a presales of about INR700 crores, both put together. But internal thing will be higher. But right now, we'll be guiding for INR700 crores.

items.statement: Target to sell minimum 1 lakh sq ft additional in One Business Bay during FY27
items.quote: But we are seeing good traction, and our target is to at least minimum sell a further 1 lakh square feet in One Business Bay. That's our minimum target.

items.quote: So see, right now, I mean, we've achieved roughly about an average of INR50,000 per square foot. So I think there will be appreciation as a project goes along, right?

items.quote: Suraj One Business Bay, our marquee commercial development in Mahim has witnessed strong sales traction since its launch with approximately 33% of inventory sold post launch, demonstrating healthy demand and strong absorption for our commercial offering.

items.statement: Current inventory mainly in commercial and Value Luxury segments; Luxury segment launches planned post society tie-ups
items.quote: So actually, in the Luxury segment, as we speak, we do not have a lot of inventory in the ongoing projects. It is majorly the commercial project and the Value Luxury, which we have inventory.

items.statement: Net debt INR614 crores as of June 2026 (gross debt INR646.94 crores, cash INR33.03 crores); debt expected to rise temporarily with new launches then decline
items.quote: As of June 2026, the company's net debt stood at INR614 crores, primarily reflecting capital deployment towards business development activities, strategic acquisitions and investments in ongoing and upcoming projects.

items.statement: Expects better ADR and stronger revenue from October to March; H2 better than H1.
items.quote: Therefore, we expect to achieve better ADR and stronger revenue from October to March, while April to June is comparatively slower.

items.statement: Hopeful of around 5% YoY ADR growth for the year.
items.quote: We are expecting, we are quite hopeful.

items.statement: Top line and bottom line will improve this year with Devprayag and Bandhavgarh additions.
items.quote: So, these three products are such that this year, our top line and bottom line will improve both the numbers.

items.statement: Expects H2 FY27 EBITDA margins better than same period last year.
items.quote: We expect our margins in the second half to be better compared with the same period last year.

items.statement: Aims to maintain 30% EBITDA margin; new properties initially lower it.
items.quote: we try our best to maintain 30% but when new properties come in, they lower the numbers but when it becomes stable.

items.statement: Mathura project total cost ₹49 crore; ₹32 crore HDFC loan at 8.14%.

items.statement: Sheopur Fort total budget ₹25 crore; ₹17.5 crore HDFC loan; 35-40 rooms this year.
items.quote: Our objective is to complete the entire project within the overall ₹25 crore budget. Around ₹10.5 crore will be funded through internal accruals, while we are taking a loan of approximately ₹17.5 crore from HDFC Bank.

items.statement: Kukru Jungle Camp 15-20 tents, investment ₹7-7.5 crore, operational by end FY28.
items.quote: Our plan is to set up good 15-20 tents. So, we will invest around 7-7.5 crores in this project.

items.statement: Devprayag 22 rooms, max expenditure within ₹1 crore to operationalize.
items.quote: Overall, we expect the maximum expenditure to be within ₹1 crore to make the property operational.

items.statement: Mathura and Sheopur to open in FY28; Kukru by end FY28.
items.quote: So, Mathura and Sheopur will come in FY28.

items.statement: Mathura annual revenue estimate ₹18-20 crore; downside comfortable at ₹12 crore.
items.quote: For Mathura, our broad revenue estimate is around ₹18–20 crore annually.

items.statement: Sheopur first-year revenue at least ₹12 crore with 35 rooms.
items.quote: For Sheopur, in the first year, assuming we operate around 35 rooms, our estimate is that revenue should be at least ₹12 crore.

items.statement: Total debt to reach around ₹50 crore by end FY28; two-year moratorium, seven-year repayment.
items.quote: Both loans have a two-year moratorium, followed by a seven-year repayment period.

items.statement: Strengthened due diligence for land deals after two incidents; ₹50 lakh written off.
items.quote: Going forward, we have strengthened our due -diligence process, particularly for land transactions.

items.statement: Top line expected to exceed INR 2000 crores over next 2-3 years.
items.quote: INR2000 crores plus will be the company's top line. And accordingly, bottom line EBITDA will also improve.

items.statement: Sales growth expected at 10-15% with PAT improving slightly more.
items.quote: Sales growth is on average around 10% to 15%. Accordingly, EBITDA and PAT will improve, with PAT improving slightly more. Both quantities and value will see an improvement of 10% to 15%.

items.statement: Solar power to add INR 10-12 crores to bottom line annually.
items.quote: So, with this also the bottom line profit of the year will increase by INR10 crores to INR12 crores and EBITDA will also increase.

items.statement: Margins to improve in Q3/Q4 FY27 due to better conditions.
items.quote: It should improve in Quarter 3 or Quarter 4. Quarter 2 is a rainy season, so there isn't significant improvement as construction remains somewhat affected. It will improve in Quarter 3 and Quarter 4.

items.statement: 15 MW solar plant: 12 MW operational, remaining in 1.5 months; expansion next year.

items.statement: Added higher-margin products like 550D, increasing inventory.
items.quote: Additionally, we have added products like 550D and other higher-value products, which has also contributed to the higher inventory.

items.statement: Able to charge INR 1500 premium over local competitors due to service and network.
items.quote: That is why we are able to charge INR1500 more premium as compared to the local ones.

items.statement: Demand environment supportive from infrastructure, construction, real estate.
items.quote: We believe the demand environment remains supportive, particularly with continued activity in infrastructure, construction, and real estate.

items.statement: Dealer network grows 10-15% annually.
items.quote: On an annual basis, the dealer network grows by 10% to 15%.

items.statement: Inventory to normalize below INR 200 crores after Diwali.
items.quote: This will normalize after Diwali. After Diwali, it will come below INR200 crores.

items.statement: Expects FY27 revenue to be 15-20% higher than FY26, driven by new acid chloride products and portfolio diversification.
items.quote: So, this year we are expecting to be at least, almost 15% to 20% higher than what we were in the last year in terms of our revenue.

items.statement: Aspires to double revenue in the next 5-6 years through current product growth and new product commercialization.
items.quote: we are looking to double our size and business in next 5 years.

items.statement: Raises revenue growth guidance to high teens for next few quarters, retaining 20% underlying EBITDA margin guidance.
items.quote: Based on our recent performance and the current environment, we are raising our growth guidance to high teens for next few quarters while holding on to our margin range of underlying 20% EBITDA.

items.statement: Holds underlying EBITDA margin guidance at 20% going forward.
items.quote: Having said this, on margin, we are holding on to our guidance of 20% underlying margin in terms of EBITDA, and this is something which we will sustain as we go forward.

items.statement: PAT on track for double-digit growth for the full year despite Q1 decline.
items.quote: PAT delivery was in line with our estimates and is on track to deliver double-digit growth in the full year.

items.statement: Passed on entire cost increase including raw material, freight and currency through pricing.
items.quote: We were able to pass on the entire cost increase through judicious pricing across all our regions and customers.

items.statement: Europe margins expected to recover to mid-teens target range in coming quarters.
items.quote: And I think in the coming quarters, we will see Europe margins improving to our target range of mid-teens.

items.statement: Plans to double B&C market share from 8% to 16% in next few years.
items.quote: Currently, our market share is 8%. This, we believe, can go up to 16%.

items.statement: B&C growth momentum to sustain on healthy demand and investments; Oral recovering strongly.
items.quote: And with demand remaining healthy and our investments continuing to contribute, we expect this momentum to sustain.

items.statement: Merger with Indovida on track within planned timeline; CCI approval received.
items.quote: During the quarter, we received approval from the Competition Commission of India and the transaction continues to progress well. We remain on track to complete it within our planned timeline

items.statement: Actively scouting acquisitions in new formats and new markets.
items.quote: We are interested in moving into new formats, and we actively are scouting for opportunities for acquisition.

items.statement: Effective tax rate expected at 20-22% for full year.
items.quote: I think this year, on a full year basis, we should land anywhere between 20% to 22%.

items.statement: Expects high inflationary environment to persist for some time.
items.quote: At this stage, we expect to operate in a high inflationary environment for some time.

items.statement: Steady-state EBITDA expected to grow faster than revenue.
items.quote: On a steady-state basis, our EBITDA will grow faster than our revenue growth.

items.statement: Sustainable tubes now 44% of overall product mix.
items.quote: We continue to make meaningful progress on our sustainability agenda with sustainable tubes now accounting for 44% of our overall product mix.

items.statement: Thailand operations ramping up as new growth driver in significant B&C market.
items.quote: Our Thailand operations are beginning to ramp up, and Thailand is a really significant B&C market, and this ramp-up will be another growth driver as we go forward.

items.statement: Management expects to sustain current growth momentum through the rest of the year, with new programs fueling H2 growth.
items.quote: I don't see any challenges for us to sustain this growth momentum through the rest of this year in automotive.

items.statement: Group plans about Rs 15 crore capex this year; Rs 10 crore automotive, Rs 5 crore metals.
items.quote: CapEx wise at the group level, we want to invest about 15 cores this year. I would say about about 10 crores would go into the automotive segment, about five cores would go into Future tech which is the metal segment.

items.statement: Strong demand continues in Q2 for both automotive and metals segments.
items.quote: So broadly I would say strong demand continues even now in Q2 with both automotive and metals, right.

items.statement: Gross margin decline is commodity pass-through, not erosion; absolute margins remain stable.
items.quote: It's not really erosion in margin, right. This is just the impact of commodities.

items.statement: Copper and brass prices nearly doubled in twelve months, with some quarters seeing 10-30% increases.
items.quote: Over the last one year, I would say, copper prices, brass prices have almost doubled, right, in just twelve months.

items.statement: Automotive capacity utilization exceeds 85-90% in tubeless, TPMS and EV segments; tube valve still has room.
items.quote: when it comes to tubeless, TPMS and even maybe the EV segment, we are kind of, you know, running at capacity utilization levels in excess of 85-90 %, right.

items.statement: Received LOIs from AUMOVIO and SENSATA; BOSCH existing customer scaling up.
items.quote: We've received some LOIs from AUMOVIO and SENSATA these are two large global players in the TPMS census base and BOSCH, of course, is our existing customer also scaling up right now.

items.statement: Metals segment moving up value chain into special alloys with better margins, requiring foundry and extrusion equipment.
items.quote: we are now moving towards you know special alloys where there are some special alloying elements or the copper percentage is going up right, where margins are better

items.statement: Geopolitical supply chain disruptions expected over next 5-10 years; company offers vertically integrated de-risked solution.
items.quote: It's it's going to be a difficult time over the next 05-10 years.

items.statement: New EV components (charging infrastructure, motor control, battery terminals) expected to commercialize in 6-12 months.
items.quote: I would say typically six to twelve months, right. Sometimes even more.

items.statement: Debt to EBITDA targeted between 2.5 and 3 by end of year.
items.value: two and a half to three
items.quote: We are trying our best to bring that under three maybe somewhere between two and a half to three by the end of the year.

items.statement: Q1 group growth 38% YoY; about 20% volume growth, rest value growth.
items.quote: I'd say about 20 % is volume growth and the rest is, I would say value growth.

items.statement: Metals segment had slow Q1 start due to war impact; Rs 10 crore export sales undelivered.
items.quote: we have un-delivered because the Hormuz situation, sale of 10 crores not delivered on time even though we dispatch.

items.statement: FY27 revenue target is to be higher than the previous year; internal projections not disclosed.
items.quote: Yeah, so our FY 27 revenue target is that we want to be higher than the previous year, right and yeah, so jokes apart I you know, we have a lot of internal projections, but just in the interest of, you know, this is obviously completely confidential, I don't want to comment about it.

items.statement: Expects to do slightly better than annualized Q1 revenue, EBITDA and PBT this year.
items.quote: But except for Pat, if you look at PBT, beta, and revenue, I think we will do slightly better than the annualized number. So e.g., you take one 86 crores as the top line growth group console multiply by four will be somewhere higher than that and the same goes for EBITDA and PBT.

items.statement: Targets EV component vertical to reach about 100 crores over next few quarters, maybe by next year.
items.quote: See, we want to build up the EV component vertical to about hundred crores over the next few quarters. Maybe by next year we are we are trying to see whether we can grow that to about hundred crores.

items.statement: Climate control vertical should scale to about 100 crores if trade remediation and government import curbs happen.
items.quote: then we should see climate control vertical also growing to about a hundred crores very quickly because we have capacity, right, we have capacities.

items.statement: Targets 1,000 crore revenue by FY30 with plan B and C even if climatech does not pick up.
items.quote: So I'll put it this way in terms of hitting thousand crores, we have a plan for hitting thousand crores whether climatech picks up or not.

items.statement: Of 15 crores capex, 50-60% to commercialize this year, rest in FY28.
items.quote: Yeah, so I would say that, if I look at let's say 15 crowds going in, about 50 to 60 % of that will try will get commercialized in the current year itself. The rest will go into FY 28.

items.statement: Double-digit margin only when commodity prices stabilize; long game, not in next few quarters.
items.quote: Possibly that will only happen when commodity price is little bit stabilized, right. Once, you know, once you start looking at everything at constant price, then you will start seeing that percentage number creeping up.

items.statement: Absolute EBITDA run rate at 50 crores annualized vs 40 crores previous year; percentage margins optically eroded by commodity.
items.quote: Even if I were to annualize the Q1 number, obviously our ambition is to do much more than that. But even if I just take the Q1 number and annualize it, you'll realize we are somewhere close to the 50 core mark, right up from 40 cores in the previous year.

items.statement: Prices changed every three months with automotive and climate control customers; commodity spikes cause optical margin erosion.
items.quote: There will always be a catch up, right because with our automotive customers, even with our climate control customers, we change prices every three months.

items.statement: Metals expected to become 60%+ of group revenue over 2-3 years; other two verticals 40-45%.
items.quote: So, so whether we like it or not, I think metals, the way I look at over two, three years, how it will evolve, assuming that the current trend continues will be that metals will be probably 60 % plus of the group revenue and the other two will constitute the remaining 40-45 %.

items.statement: EV two-wheeler electrification to rise from 10% to 20-25% in one to one-and-a-half years.
items.quote: I can't name anybody specifically but tends to indicate that this 10 % is very quickly going to go to about 20-25 %, right. It's possibly going to happen over just maybe one, one and a half years, right.

items.statement: Q2 expected reasonably good; Q3 seasonal dip expected, climate control and metals to show traction in Q3.
items.quote: Q3 onwards once the festival season gets over, we should expect a seasonal dip, right. So we should be prepared for that.

items.statement: ROCE to move from 12.5% to 13-14% this year, 15% by mid next year; new investments target 20-25% ROCE.
items.quote: You can see right we've already moved up to about twelve and a half percent in Q. One. We are able to continue the momentum going into Q2-Q3-Q4, I think we should see twelve and a half going to maybe 13-14 % this year itself, right?

items.statement: Feed sales expected around 5,85,000 MT in FY27.
items.quote: It is estimated that the feed sales during FY27 would be around 5,85,000 MTs.

items.statement: Shrimp exports expected around 19,000 MT in FY27.
items.quote: It is estimated that exports during FY27 would be around 19,000 MTs.

items.statement: Pet food project estimated investment around INR 175 crores; land purchased for INR 25 crores.
items.quote: We are estimating around INR 175 crores investment in a pet food. Till now, we have purchased land around INR 25 crores worth of land.

items.statement: Feed price hike of around 10% taken in June.
items.quote: Around 10%, we have taken.

items.statement: PBT margin declined to 7.06% in Q1 FY27 from 13% in Q4 FY26 and 17% in Q1 FY26.
items.quote: The PBT during the quarter stood at 7.06% on revenue as compared to about 13% during Q4 FY 26 and 17% during Q1 FY26.

items.statement: FY26/27 expected challenging for aquaculture due to high feed raw material prices and export demand issues.
items.quote: To sum up, in general, FY 26/27 is expected to be a challenging season for the aquaculture industry in respect of shrimp production due to steep increase in feed raw material prices as well as exports from India and global demand for shrimp exports.

items.statement: Shrimp culture activity progressing well; farmers happy with favorable climate and farm-gate prices.
items.quote: At present, the shrimp culture activity is very good. The farmers are very happy that the culture is progressing very well with the climate is also favorable. Farm-gate prices have also been have gone up.

items.statement: Raw material prices expected to stabilize in coming months upon fresh crops arrival.
items.quote: However, due to favorable monsoon across India, El Nino effects are expected to ease and raw material prices of shrimp feed are expected to stabilize in coming months upon arrival of fresh crops.

items.statement: Pet food sales increased to INR 180 lakh in Q1 FY27 from INR 151 lakh in Q4 FY26.
items.quote: Q1 FY26/27 sales increased to INR180 lakh compared to INR151 lakhs in Q4 FY25/26, reflecting continued growth in both cat food and dog food segment.

items.statement: Pet food manufacturing facility construction to commence after approval.
items.quote: Construction activity will commence upon receipt of the necessary approval.

items.statement: US reciprocal tariff refunds pending due to ADD/CVD suspension; entries declared but not processed.
items.quote: Regarding reciprocal tariff, particularly for seafood industry, that too for India, so now the entries are under ADD and the CVD review, which are under suspension status. Unless the suspension is lifted, the CBP will not process the reciprocal tariffs. As of now, they're all under pending status.

items.statement: Shrimp production estimated 8-9 lakh MT in CY2026; feed consumption 11-12 lakh MT.
items.quote: On the basis of estimated shrimp production of about 8-9 lakh MTs in calendar year 2026, the feed consumption is estimated to be about 1 1-12 lakh MTs.

items.statement: Government committee with consultant working on feed price mechanism.
items.quote: The government has, in fact, constituted a committee with one of the big four consultants. They are working on that how to handle this at the price because we have to keep in view not only the feed manufacturers, but also to the farmers and also how it becomes a sustainable activity for the farmers.

items.statement: Targets INR5,000 crore revenue by 2030 with 25-30% annual growth.
items.quote: Your company is poised to achieve a revenue mark of INR5,000 crores by 2030. We are targeting annual revenue growth of approximately 25% to 30%, supported by our strong B2B foundation, expanding B2C and digital ecosystem and value creation across every segment of the business.

items.statement: Expects 30% overall top-line growth for the full year.
items.quote: In that case, yes, that overall today's top line, if you consider, we would be able to achieve 30% growth.

items.statement: Plans 8-10 new stores over 3-4 years; retail to reach 40% of revenue by FY2030.
items.quote: B2C business will be the key growth driver going forward, and we have a very aggressive plan to launch 8 to 10 stores over the next 3 to 4 years across geographies.

items.statement: Retail share targeted at 40% of overall revenue by FY2030.
items.quote: Our retail expansion is aimed to accelerating our B2C growth and increasing the B2C contribution to approximately 40% of overall revenue by FY 2030.

items.statement: Rising retail share expected to lift overall EBITDA and PAT margins.
items.quote: Since the overall share of the retail is going to increase to 40%, we are targeting to reach at least 40% of the retail sale by FY 2030. So in that case, the share of retail increases, then our margins of what they say, retail sale will be -- our margins -- retail margins will be high.

items.statement: Flagship showroom achieving 80-85% of INR500 crore revenue target; monthly run rate INR30-35 crore.
items.quote: We have already defined that the showroom is going to fetch us in a revenue of around INR500 crores and somewhere around 80% to 85% of that we have been working, and we are achieving that.

items.statement: Q1 jewellery volume/quantum growth was around 15%.
items.quote: So the growth in the quantum was around 15%.

items.statement: Main board migration process expected to complete in about 2 months.
items.quote: Surely, we would be -- the migration process will be completed in another 2 months, we believe.

items.statement: New stores to be company-owned initially, using asset-light leased model.
items.quote: We said no, we are going to operate with an asset-light model so that we will have and leased the property for that and use it for our development.

items.statement: Expansion funded via internal earnings; debt may be raised if required.
items.quote: We are planning a retail development of 40% to reach there, we have our internal earnings, we will be utilizing it for expansion. And certain cases, as and when required by the required, the management will be deciding as and when it may be raised by debt or some other means.

items.statement: Steep gold price rises cause 1-2 week demand slowdown before normalizing.
items.quote: And every time when there is a steep rise in the prices, yes, there is a certain slowdown of, say, for a fortnight or 2 weeks. Then that price get digested.

items.statement: Sources products at lower making charges than market, offering better pricing than peers.
items.quote: And competitively, we are able to source the right product at the right making charge a lower making charge compared to the market since we have been dealing with both B2B and B2C segment.

items.statement: Added Kundan Jadau and diamond jewellery in B2B to improve margins.
items.quote: So we have added up Kundan Jadau jewellery and even diamond jewellery for our B2B segment also. So we have been working on improving the margins of B2B.

items.statement: Old gold exchange is 15-20% of total sales, up from last year.
items.quote: So the old gold exchange is total -- out of the total sale, old gold exchange is somewhere around 15% to 20%. Now it has increased. Last year, it was less after the Modi ji statement, it has increased.

items.statement: New programs with Mahindra, Tata Motors, Maruti Suzuki started production; volumes expected to progressively ramp up.
items.quote: Several new programs with our key customers, including Mahindra, Tata Motors, Maruti Suzuki, have started production during this quarter.

items.statement: Several new programs in pipeline expected to commence production in coming quarters.
items.quote: In addition to these programs that have already commenced, we have several ofher new programs in the pipeline with a number of them expected to commence production in the coming quarters.

items.statement: Investing ahead of customer requirements in capacity additions, automation, and technology upgrades.
items.quote: Our customers are significantly investing in additional capacity, new vehicle programs, and localization, and we are investing ahead of these requirements in capacity additions, automation, and technology upgrades.

items.statement: Cautious near-term outlook for EMOSS Europe due to EV commercial vehicle slowdown and reduced program visibility.
items.quote: As a result, we remain cautious about the near-term outlook for EMOSS Europe.

items.statement: EMOSS revenue fell to INR13.8 crores in Q1 from INR29 crores previous quarter; management taking cautious view.
items.quote: the business reported a revenue of INR13.8 crores during the quarter compared to INR29 crores in the previous quarter.

items.statement: Standalone EBITDA margin 13%, PAT margin 9% in Q1.
items.quote: the total income increased by 6.6% quarter-on-quarter to INR173 crores, EBITDA margin stood at 13%, and PAT margin stood at 9%.

items.statement: Consolidated EBITDA margin about 10%, PAT about 4.2%.
items.quote: The consolidated business decreased by 2.4% and was at INR200.8 crores, EBITDA margin was about 10%, and profit after tax was about 4.2%.

items.statement: Standalone total income grew 6.6% QoQ to INR173 crores; net profit INR14.88 crores, up 12.5%.
items.quote: The company's total income stood at INR173 crores, registering a growth of 6.6% compared to the last quarter.

items.statement: MEMCO recorded revenue of INR14 crores in Q1, focusing on Bosch, Delphi, Endress+Hauser relationships.
items.quote: Our subsidiary MEMCO recorded a revenue of INR14 crores during Q1 and continues to focus on strengthening relationships with key customers like Bosch, Delphi, Endress+Hauser, and a few others.

items.statement: Actively evaluating acquisition opportunities within India to grow into new products, markets, and customers.
items.quote: We are also actively looking at acquisition opportunities within India, and that will be a way for us to grow into new products, new markets, new customers, and so on.

items.statement: European automotive industry restructuring and slower EV customer decision-making reduce program visibility.
items.quote: Against this backdrop, customer decision-making in the EV segment has become slower and program visibility has reduced.

items.statement: EHCV platform developed and delivered to a customer, currently undergoing evaluation and field trials.
items.quote: We have developed the EHCV platform and delivered the vehicle to a customer, and the customer is still undergoing evaluation and field trials at this point.

items.statement: Focus on protecting EMOSS business, managing costs and investments, evaluating based on customer traction and returns.
items.quote: Our focus at this point is protecting the business and carefully managing costs and investments, and we will continue to evaluate the business based on customer fraction, cash requirements, and potential returns.
